_source: NAC's Google Business Profile. Each one is verbatim from the 'New Google Review' notification sent to nick@nacelectrical.com.au, so the wording, the spelling and the reviewer's name are the customer's own and have not been tidied. Twelve notifications were found; this is all twelve.
_permission: Every one of these is already published by its author on Google, which is PERMISSION.PUBLIC_SOURCE in designer/engines/presentation-content.mjs. That is what makes them showable; it is not a substitute for NAC's own approval, which is the `approved` flag.
_ratingsPending: THE STAR RATINGS ARE NOT IN THE NOTIFICATION EMAILS — the star row is an image with no alt text, so there is nothing to read. They are null here rather than guessed. reviewPublishable() refuses a review without a rating of 1 to 5, so none of these can appear on a quote until the real figures are entered from the Google Business Profile dashboard.
_dates: The notifications carry the month and year only (for example 'Th Aug, 2026'), so that is what is recorded. No day has been invented.
_suburbs: The notifications do not name the customer's suburb, so none is recorded. publicSuburb() prints nothing for a blank one.
_howToUse: Open /quote-presentation.html, sign in, Reviews, then 'Import Google reviews'. Each one arrives Withheld. Fill the star rating and tick 'Approved for marketing' and it becomes publishable.
